last_episode_to_air.name: E-Scream
last_episode_to_air.overview: The gang visits a video game convention to play the video games, but the cute Osomon creatures that were the highlight of the show turn into monsters.

name: What's New, Scooby-Doo?
overview: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery, Inc. gang are launched into the 21st century, with new mysteries to solve.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Shaggy, Scooby, Velma, Daphne and Fred have creepy adventures and new mysteries to solve. Always meeting some new ghost or monster, the band of teens and their pal Scooby-Doo have new gadgets and inventions that help on their detective adventures.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: There's no business like ghost business and when you join Mystery Inc. you get to travel! Start packing because you're going on an endless spooktacular summer vacation, visiting countries from around the ghostly globe – including Egypt, Greece, Tokyo and Transylvania… even the snowy glaciers of the South Pole! Thank goodness you're not afraid of ghosts...or vampires, mummies, an invisible madman and fire-breathing toy dragons!

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The third season features everyone's favorite crime solvers in a number of sports-themed settings. From a wrestling match gone wrong to a haunted stock car race, and even a mini-golf tournament terrorized by a metallic clown, the gang keeps their cool in any arena. But Season Three offers more than just spooky sports events as the globetrotting gang of ghostbusters visits Paris, Moscow, Hong Kong, Australia, and the Old West. Ruh-roh, indeed!
